The goal is eventually self-healing algedonic feedback loops of PRs.

To make it self-healing instead of merely reactive, I’d treat these as
the missing pieces:

 1. No silent failures — auto-pr.yml should fail hard when PR creation 
fails, so pain is surfaced immediately instead of disappearing.
 2. Trusted feedback only — secret-backed side effects like Linear sync 
need tighter scoping, so hostile or malformed PR metadata can’t inject 
false signals into the loop.
 3. Periodic reconciliation — the system should not rely only on 
incoming events; it should also rescan open PRs on a schedule and 
re-derive truth from GitHub state, correcting drift automatically.

That would turn the current setup from event-driven automation into a
real self-healing control system: detect pain, project state, reconcile
truth, and re-arm the correct next action without manual babysitting. -- IMPLEMENT!
